result:
The 3-second end card is in `s5/index.html`. `npx hyperframes check --json` now returns ok with no warnings.

- **Look:** it's a 1920×1080 card on the same dark background as `s4`. It shows `github.com/` in white with `mohessaid/girth` in mint green.
- **Motion:** `github.com/` is on screen from frame 0, so the first frame isn't empty. `mohessaid/girth` slides in from the right and fades up over 0.8s, starting at 0.2s. A mint underline then draws across, starting at 0.6s. The URL keeps a slow scale drift to the end, and the underline fades to white from 1.6s, so there's motion all the way through.
- **Check fixes:** the first run flagged an empty first frame, a missing id on the card, a `data-var-text` binding with no matching variable, and a nested-timeline-element warning. I fixed these by starting with part of the URL visible, giving the card an id, removing the binding and un-timing the card.

I also recorded the choices (duration 3, end-card format, mask-slide-reveal motion) with the `girth made` command.
